unsectioned.player: I'm sorry, I'm looking for the blast furnace?

unsectioned.npc: Do I look like a guide to you?

unsectioned.player: No, you look like a hard-working dwarf, but can you please tell me where the blast furnace is?

unsectioned.npc: Alright, just head down the stairs, it's easy to find.

unsectioned.player: If you were any shorter you wouldn't exist.
What are you dwarves doing in this factory?

unsectioned.npc: Working of course, can't you see that?
Refining the ore that is being brought into the factory, of course.
It means you should stop asking so many questions and get back to work!
The Consortium does and that's all you need to know.

unsectioned.player: But what company? I thought there were all these different companies?

unsectioned.npc: Oh yes, all the major companies own this plant. It's too vital to be in the hands of one company alone.

unsectioned.player: And what exactly are you doing here?

unsectioned.npc: I tire of these questions. Let me get back to work!
